title: Hit 8,000 steps per day.
subtitle: Step floor
rationale: Use a step floor as the simplest observable proxy for a genuinely active day.

evidence.summary: Meta-analysis of 15 cohorts shows progressively lower all-cause mortality up to about 8,000-10,000 steps per day in adults under 60.

sources.label: Daily steps and all-cause mortality meta-analysis

indications: Step counts sit under 6,000 on most workdays.
Movement happens but concentrates into single workouts.
